title: Rabbi Chalafta of Caesarea

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Genesis Rabbah 50:11. In Song of Songs Rabbah 4:11, Rabbi Huna and Rabbi Chalafta of Caesarea speak in the name of Resh Lakish.

notes.text: No matching named paragraph is supplied for the stated Bereshit Rabbah 40:11 or Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:11 occurrences of Chalafta of Caesarea. These citations remain open; no claim of absence from the entire works or cause of the discrepancy is made.

Hyman’s print (vol. II, p. 454) cites Genesis Rabbah 50:11. The supplied Hebrew gives 40:11, the reference discussed in the earlier note. In Genesis Rabbah 50:11, Chalafta of Caesarea speaks about the favor shown to Lot for honoring the angel. Song of Songs Rabbah 4:11 names Rabbi Huna and Chalafta of Caesarea together in Resh Lakish’s name, in the comparison between the bride’s twenty-four ornaments and the twenty-four books of Scripture.
